title: Lint baselines are ratchets; all now empty; never pnpm baseline
context: Linter rules were introduced against existing codebase; violations needed recording to avoid false failures.
decision: Baselines (eslint-suppressions.json, clippy-baseline.json, comment-baseline.json) are ratchets: may shrink, may not grow. All three now empty. Never run `pnpm baseline` (absorbs violations). Use single-check forms with commit message reasoning.
consequences: New violations cannot be silently absorbed. Baseline represents deliberate decisions. Re-baselining requires explicit reasoning in commit. Once empty, staying empty is enforced by failing when count increases.
